note: Photos for measuring how well Claude places damage boxes. truth boxes are [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the image from the top left, drawn by eye on a gridded copy of each photo and checked on an overlay. optional boxes are places where damage is plausible but cannot be confirmed from the photo: a box Claude draws there is neither rewarded nor counted as false.

photos.title: Rear quarter panel, passenger side
photos.claim: Claim: Parking lot scrape, rear quarter panel. Loss type: Collision. Insured item: a white four door sedan. The insured reports that another car struck the rear corner in a parking lot.

photos.title: Side of the pickup, behind the cab
photos.claim: Claim: Side scrape on a delivery pickup. Loss type: Collision. Insured item: a blue pickup truck. The insured reports that a passing vehicle scraped the side behind the cab.

photos.title: Driver side from the front
photos.claim: Claim: Door dent from a parking incident. Loss type: Collision. Insured item: a white 1963 Vauxhall Velox. The insured reports a dent in a door after the car was parked on the street.

photos.title: Rear of the car after the storm
photos.claim: Claim: Storm damage to a parked car. Loss type: Wind or Hail. Insured item: a white sedan. The insured reports that hail broke the rear window while the car was parked.

optional.label: trunk lid and shelf under the glass

photos.title: Rear window after the hail
photos.claim: Claim: Hail broke the rear window. Loss type: Wind or Hail. Insured item: a silver sedan. The insured reports that large hail broke the rear window and dented the body.

photos.title: Windshield from inside
photos.claim: Claim: Cracked windshield. Loss type: Glass. Insured item: a passenger car. The insured reports that a stone struck the windshield on the highway and the crack spread.

photos.title: Front of the house after the storm
photos.claim: Claim: Storm damage to the roof. Loss type: Wind or Hail. Insured item: a single story brick house. The insured reports that a storm tore open the roof.

optional.label: debris and fascia at the right

photos.title: Roof slope, close up
photos.claim: Claim: Wind tore shingles from the roof. Loss type: Wind or Hail. Insured item: a house with an asphalt shingle roof. The insured reports that high winds lifted and broke shingles.

photos.title: Ceiling by the outside wall
photos.claim: Claim: Water came through the ceiling. Loss type: Water. Insured item: a house. The insured reports a roof leak that stained a bedroom ceiling.

truth.label: peeling paint at the wall joint

photos.title: Family room after the water
photos.claim: Claim: Burst pipe flooded the finished basement. Loss type: Water. Insured item: a house. The insured reports that a pipe burst and water filled the basement family room.

optional.label: wall and back of the room

photos.title: Side of the car at the curb
photos.claim: Claim: Scratch along the side reported after valet parking. Loss type: Collision. Insured item: a black Toyota Century sedan. The insured reports a scratch along one side after the car was returned by a valet.

photos.title: Living room and kitchen
photos.claim: Claim: Water stain reported on the living room ceiling. Loss type: Water. Insured item: a single wide manufactured home. The insured reports a leak above the living room.
